player_prompt.intro:
Mwaba ukwamba 2048 pa bodo ya {board_size}x{board_size}. Icupo lyenu ni kufikila kwa tile ya {target_tile} kwa kuyayusha nambari zilizo sawa pamo!
Mipango inayowezekana: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Matayi yanakwata ukwata, na kuongeza thamani yao.

invalid_move.no_change: Lelo te kuti baluke. Bakasabankanya bafwaya ukwaluka mu fyo balecita.
